Farewell to Decorum

I think this is the same tune as on track six of Hamish Moore’s “Farewell to Decorum” album. I pair it with Atholl Highlanders - but on Gaita, rather than GHB. The D part is wonderful!

Galician, X:2

My version

↳ Posted by JACKB on July 21st, 2015.

Galician, X:3

Highland pipe arrangement by Robert Mathieson with four non-repeating extra parts (the first four parts repeat as normal).

I’m not sure if the lack of repeats is an error; the arrangement, seemingly from some legit source, has numerous timing errors (the dotted quarter-note which ends several bars isn’t dotted).

↳ Posted by Richard D Cook on July 7th, 2026.

Re: Galician

As a gaiteiro of 25 years every one of the settings so far seems to have the bar lines in the wrong place. Its pretty common for muiñeiras to have a half bar anacrusis and this sounds like one of those, the first beat should be on the C not the F. To be honest this sounds like various parts of various muiñeiras spliced together, does anyone know the origins of the tune?.

↳ Posted by bagpie on July 8th, 2026.
